boundary.description: From the junction of Thicketford Road and Blair Lane, along Blair Lane, New Lane, Stitch-Mi-Lane, Arthur Lane, to and S along Bolton – Bury District boundary (Blackshaw Brook) to the point opposite Crows Nest and by a bee-line W to Crows Nest, Radcliffe Road, Croft Side and by E boundary of Darcy Level Gravel Pits to River Croal. N along River Croal, River Tonge to Folds Road and by a bee-line to and along Entwistle Street, Ainsworth Lane, Abington Road (both sides in St Brendan’s Parish), Crompton Way and Thicketford Road to its junction with Blair Lane.
